uncertain_points.claim: ctrl_state_logic may take a value not in the dma_ctrl_state_e enum. No error checking or safe default is enforced in this chunk. An illegal value propagates directly to ctrl_state_q.
uncertain_points.risk: The downstream FSM may enter an invalid state, bypass security checks, or deadlock.

security_implications: The dma module uses hardware-controlled REGWEN to lock most registers during active DMA operation. For registers that cannot be locked this way (e.g., CONTROL register), a capture mechanism records their values at operation start and only the captured value (via control_q) is used subsequently. If capture_state fails or if control_q does not hold the correct captured value, software may be able to modify critical control registers mid-operation, potentially causing privilege escalation, access control bypass, or DMA transfer corruption. Additionally, an illegal encoding on ctrl_state_logic could cause the FSM to misbehave, possibly bypassing the capture mechanism or accessing illegal addresses.
